sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Stupid alarm, why did you die today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicked about being late, with a burst of irritated self-directed frustration at the alarm for ruining her first day.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Mom's going to say it was fate punishing me for scrolling at midnight...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and self-mocking, half-panicked about being late but trying to laugh off her bad luck with an exasperated, embarrassed grin.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Wait, seriously? They never open this gate.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly shifting from panicked frustration to startled, hopeful curiosity, feeling a little relieved at the unexpected shortcut while still wary that something is off.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Yeah, that was the problem, thanks.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and irritated from being late, but her sharp reply also shows a burst of defensive sarcasm and embarrassed frustration at being told the obvious.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels wary and puzzled, with her earlier panic easing into cautious curiosity as she tries to make sense of the girl’s oddly precise warning.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled and suspicious, with a quick flash of self-consciousness at being read so accurately by a stranger.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: How do you know that before the board goes up?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and uneasy, trying to sound sharp and in control while her mind races at the unsettling feeling that this girl knows far too much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. Creepy. Helpful, maybe, but creepy.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and uneasy, but trying to regain control with nervous humor and a bold, talkative edge.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Yes! I might actually make it!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden burst of relieved, energized optimism as the immediate panic eases and she dares to believe the morning might still turn around.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into stunned, uneasy realization, feeling a sharp mix of relief at the warning and fear at how narrowly she avoided something dangerous.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: She said not to use the east stairs.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp, uneasy jolt of vindication and fear, realizing the girl’s eerie warning may have saved her from something genuinely dangerous.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, come on. Don't do this to me on day one.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of disbelief and rising anxiety, with a frustrated edge as the eerie warning suddenly makes her feel trapped and personally targeted on her very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Fine. School first. Panic attack later.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, joking composure to stay functional, while underneath she’s shaken, anxious, and trying hard not to spiral after realizing the warning may have saved her.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

gpt.rationale: Aoi is mostly expressively in character—snappy anger, open surprise, bright relief—but a few beats read off, especially the joking 'fate punishing me' on happiness and the nervous laugh marked only as surprise.

claude.rationale: Expressive, mood-driven choices fit the extrovert, but 'happiness' on the wry self-deprecating joke and repeated 'surprise' for distinct beats (suspicion, nervous laugh) blur several emotional turns.
